verdict.headline: New features added including Gallery View and AI Summaries; verify API key handling
verdict.release_summary: The v1.15.11_3.5.0 release introduces several new features, including a Gallery View for media browsing, a revamped settings interface, and enhanced AI Summaries with support for cloud-hosted models. Notably, the AI Summaries feature allows users to supply their own API keys, raising potential security concerns regarding key management. Additionally, the introduction of native poll voting and creation features utilizes web session cookies, which may expose user accounts if not handled securely. Overall, while the new features enhance user experience, the handling of sensitive data warrants a closer look.
top_changes_to_review: 60704409 by @nickclyde: 'AI Summaries: cloud-hosted model support (OpenRouter / Gemini / custom)' — verify API key handling and storage in standardUserDefaults.
aa665fa4 by @jordanearle: 'Add native poll voting and creation' — check the security of web session cookie usage for authentication.
6c147b3b by @icpryde: 'Add selectable modern Reddit Chat and Modmail' — review token_v2 handling for secure authentication.
